id.title: Id
id.description: The code table's id: its file name without .lua.

path.title: Path
path.description: The code table file, relative to the node (mapping/codetables/<id>.lua).

name.title: Name
name.description: The table's display name (empty when the file can't be read).

from.title: From
from.description: The From system: name, system (FHIR URL), oid and hl7 where known.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: The number of rows the table holds (entries of its map).

without_to.title: Without To
without_to.description: The number of rows whose To code is empty.

used_by.title: Used By
used_by.description: The rules, in any map of the node, that name this table: {map, file, rule} each.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: sha256:<hex> of the file's UTF-8 text.

error.title: Error
error.description: The reader's message when the file can't be read; null otherwise.

line.title: Line
line.description: The line the read error is on, when the reader gives one.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Every code table of the node, in id order.

400.description: The node is not a Data Map node (not_a_data_map).
